text:
Maya: Hey team — I processed a per-diem advance for Eileen on 2024-05-22 (ADV-1987). She just filed expenses today but total receipts are less than the advance, and some receipts are in JPY. What do we do for the shortfall? Do we ask for bank repayment or offset via payroll? :thinking:
Omar: If it's under $75 we usually ask them to submit a short explanation and we close it, but anything bigger we either request payback or payroll deduction depending on timing. what's the amount?
Maya: Shortfall is ¥14,200 (~$95 at the rate used). She travelled to Tokyo. She paid local transit + a hotel incidental that didn't have a VAT invoice.
Sam: @Maya do we have Eileen on an upcoming payroll cutoff? If yes, payroll deduction is easiest. If not, collecting by bank transfer avoids messing with benefits.
Maya: Payroll cutoff is next Wednesday. Eileen asked to avoid immediate bank transfer.
Li: Quick note on FX: per-diem was advanced in USD using the corporate card FX rate (1 USD = 145 JPY). Receipts are JPY cash. We need to pick a conversion rule: use transaction FX (if card) or the travel date rate for cash. Our policy says travel cash should use the date-of-expense rate from Oanda.
Maya: Got it — that pushes the USD shortfall to $98.50.
Zoe: expense-bot here — flagging ADV-1987: missing VAT invoice for hotel; policy requires an admin note. Suggest adding `Missing VAT, reimbursed at gross` in the report. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks! For payroll deduction, finance, do you need an authorization form signed? Eileen approved payroll offset in a DM but we don't have a signed paper.
Li: We need an electronic ack in Concur or a signed email. Can you ask Eileen to reply in the thread with "I authorize payroll offset for ADV-1987"? That satisfies audit.
Maya: pinging Eileen — can you confirm here?
expense-bot: Reminder: per-diem advances older than 90 days require manager approval to write off.
Eileen: I authorize payroll offset for ADV-1987. Sorry for the delay — hotel paperwork was messy.
Maya: Perfect. Li — proceed with payroll deduction for $98.50 and mark the advance closed. Please confirm when done.
Li: Will do. I'll create a ledger adjustment and send payroll the deduction file today. Accounting reference: `GL-ADV-1987-CLS`. If payroll needs a code snippet for the file, use this CSV header: `employee_id,amount,currency,reason,reference`
Omar: tiny FYI — can we add a short line to travel policy that cash receipts use Oanda rate to avoid back-and-forth?
Sam: Yes please — update makes approvals smoother.
Maya: I'll draft a short line and post to #policy for review. Thanks everyone :pray:
